categories.evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies src/wallet/rpc/encrypt.cpp to deprecate in-place wallet encryption.
categories.rationale: Deprecating in-place wallet encryption addresses serious fund-safety and backup hazards. As the PR notes, generating new keys post-encryption invalidates pre-encryption backups—risking fund loss upon restore—while also leaving plaintext key remnants on storage and altering descriptor spending conditions (#26607).
